items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I'm going to Aunt Jessie's or Aunt Margaret's

ctx.x: (NOT CLEAR) ...I paid the guys off in watermelons. Every Saturday we would be off... So I had my watermelon patch and every time we'd get the watermelons we'd take them down - and the dam is still there, it's still there, and the walk over it. You know, I'm going to Aunt Jessie's or Aunt Margaret's or somebody and the walk over it, it's still there.
So you said you had your own watermelon patch. How large was the family plot, the farm?
